title: smime-tree sign.rs: boundary_from_content is a stale name — boundary is now randomly generated
description: sign.rs: the function is named boundary_from_content but the boundary is generated from 16 random bytes, not derived from content (an earlier design used SHA-256 of content). The name misleads: a reader expects the function to do something content-dependent. Suggested rewrite: rename to random_boundary(content: &[u8]) or generate_boundary(content: &[u8]); the content parameter is still needed for the collision check but should not appear in the name.
